comments:
There is no tonic prolongation here, so there is no presentation, even though we have 2-measures units that are (sequentially) repeated.

This specific situation is described in Caplin, 246:

"Contrasting Middle + Continuation

Following a contrasting middle, a passage with continuational characteristics
brings the second part to a close with a PAC. Th e melodic-motivic content of
this continuation may relate back to a continuational passage from the fi rst part
or bring new material.

If the contrasting middle itself is built as a continuation (a frequent situa-
tion, as discussed in Chap. 7, p. 211), then the second part as a whole consists of
two continuation phrases: the fi rst closing with an HC, the second with a PAC."
